title: Asymptotic-Preserving Tensor Neural Networks for 3D High-Field Kinetic Equations with Applications to Uncertainty Quantification
abstract: arXiv:2611.07364v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kinetic equations in the high-field regime describe particle transport dominated by electric-field acceleration and collisional relaxation. These equations are widely used in simulations of plasmas and semiconductor devices. Typical models include the Vlasov--Poisson--Fokker--Planck (VPFP) and Boltzmann--Poisson systems. Their high dimensionality and multiscale nature pose two of the major challenges to accurate and efficient numerical solution. To address these challenges, we propose an asymptotic-preserving tensor neural network (APTNN) method. Specifically, to reduce high-dimensional computational costs and memory requirements, we adopt the canonical polyadic (CP) decomposition structure of TNNs to approximate their solutions. We show that the equation residuals retain this decomposition form, allowing high-dimensional loss integrals to be evaluated through combinations of one-dimensional integrals. translated_title: 渐近保持张量神经网络求解三维高场动理学方程及其在不确定性量化中的应用
translated_abstract: 高场区的动理学方程描述了以电场加速和碰撞弛豫为主导的粒子输运过程。这类方程被广泛应用于等离子体和半导体器件的模拟中，典型模型包括Vlasov–Poisson–Fokker–Planck（VPFP）方程组和Boltzmann–Poisson方程组。其高维性与多尺度特性是精确且高效数值求解面临的两大主要挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种渐近保持张量神经网络（APTNN）方法。具体而言，为降低高维计算成本与内存需求，我们采用张量神经网络（TNN）的典范多线性（CP）分解结构来逼近方程的解。我们证明方程残差可保持这种分解形式，从而使得高维损失积分能够通过一维积分的组合来计算，由此带来的计算与存储方面的优势……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出渐近保持张量神经网络（APTNN）方法，利用CP分解将高维损失积分化为一维积分的组合，从而高效求解三维高场动理学方程并应用于不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an asymptotic-preserving tensor neural network (APTNN) method that leverages CP decomposition to reduce high-dimensional loss integrals to combinations of one-dimensional integrals, enabling efficient solution of 3D high-field kinetic equations with applications to uncertainty quantification.
